description: This Java class 'AppStatusListItemController' manages the display and dismissal behavior of app status list items in an Android application, specifically handling apps that are downloading, ready to install, or recently installed.

classes.name: AppStatusListItemController
classes.description: Controller class for managing app status list items, including their display state and dismissal actions.

methods.name: AppStatusListItemController
methods.description: Constructor initializing the controller with activity context and item view.

methods.name: getCurrentViewState
methods.description: Returns the current view state of the app item, including status text based on app update status.

methods.name: getStatusText
methods.description: Determines the status text to display based on the app's update status.

methods.name: canDismiss
methods.description: Indicates that the list item can be dismissed.

methods.name: onDismissApp
methods.description: Handles the dismissal of an app item, including canceling downloads or undoing installations.
